> Let's get busy coding.

The assignment for the course is divided in two parts:

-   **Assignment - Part A**:
    -   Work done in connection to Computer lab 1.
    -   Deadline for submission: September 30, 2026.
    -   Feedback to students: October 11, 2026.
    -   The assignment in different formats: [html](assignment/AssignmentPartA.qmd) \| [pdf](assignment/AssignmentPartA.pdf) \| [quarto](https://github.com/mattiasvillani/BayesLearnCourse/raw/master/assignment/AssignmentPartA.qmd)
    -   Dataset for Assignment, part A: [ericsson](https://github.com/mattiasvillani/BayesLearnCourse/raw/master/assignment/ericsson.RData) 
-   **Assignment - Part B**:
    -   Work done in connection to Computer labs 2 and 3.
    -   Deadline for submission: October 13, 2026.
    -   Feedback to students: October 20, 2026.
    -   The assignment in different formats: [html](assignment/AssignmentPartB.qmd) \| [pdf](assignment/AssignmentPartB.pdf) \| [quarto](https://github.com/mattiasvillani/BayesLearnCourse/raw/master/assignment/AssignmentPartB.qmd)
    -   Dataset for Assignment, part B: [bugs](https://github.com/mattiasvillani/BayesLearnCourse/raw/master/assignment/bugs.csv)

Each student will have access to his/her report when writing the exam. Students are allowed and encouraged to polish their assignment reports before uploading them for the exam. It is not allowed to add additional information unrelated to the assignments in the uploaded reports. Each uploaded report will be checked before the exam.

::: callout-note
Computer lab 4 is **after** the deadlines of both assignments, and should therefore be used to ask questions about both Part A and B of the assignment, and polishing the assignments before the written exam.
:::

::: callout-caution
The scheduled time for computer labs will not be enough for doing the assignments.
:::
